escenas.texto: This week in Oceania, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over three hundred and twenty-six million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Oceania edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Oceania. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, Ingrid Munoz, with “When Cleaning Gel Turns Your Face GREEN!”. Over six point six million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.
Next up, number nine, xxsni, with “The way Manon regretted what she said”. Over nine point two million views. A Short of just thirty-one seconds. It also has eight hundred and fifty-nine comments.

Number eight, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “I think we're seeing a glimpse of future Ben...”. Over nine point eight million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just two days.

Next up, number seven, Merry Latte, with “Comment grinch if your car needs one!”. Over ten million views. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eleven seconds.
Number six, Bloxy Productions, with “In this world rumors become true.”. Over ten million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

Coming in at number five, from Australia, Jasmin and James, with “We can’t believe we just hit 43m family members!”. Over eleven million views. A Short of just twenty-two seconds. It also has two hundred and three comments.

Next up, number four, Ivan Hutsul, with “Not Your Average Ice Cream!”. Over fifteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twelve thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nine seconds.

Bronze medal, RpmCentralTV, with “Soaked?”. Over twenty-two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nine seconds.

Silver medal, SOS Pals, with “Ever parent needs this for their kids!”. Over twenty-nine million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, Dino Says, with “Comment DINO if you want one!”. Over thirty-nine million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nineteen seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. At number ten, from Australia, Bridey Drake, with a video posted four days ago. Over one thousand comments. A Short of just fifty-eight seconds. It also has over three point eight million views.

Number nine, from Australia, Skill Up, with a video posted six days ago. Over two thousand comments. A video over twenty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over seven hundred and forty thousand views.

Number eight, Jack C, with “I’ll be waiting”. Over two thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.

In position number seven, RpmCentralTV, with “Soaked?”. Over two thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nine seconds.
At number six, from Australia, TGG, with “Gta 6: game files datamined gta 6 online hints...”. Over two thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over one point two million views.

At number five, from Australia, Lily Jay, with “Muslims making HISTORY”. Over four thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over two point six million views.

At number four, from Australia, I did a thing, with “I made a bizzare invention that blows up clouds”. Over five thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over three point nine million views.

Bronze medal, RexCore, with “Roblox has 5 hours left”. Over six thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about nine thousand, two hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It got there in just two days.

Silver medal, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “I think we're seeing a glimpse of future Ben...”. Over six thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and seventy thousand views per hour. It got there in just two days.
And here it is. Number one most commented, from Australia, NickandCarrie, with “Which one is your favourite?”. Over nine thousand comments. It also has over two point eight million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Australia, Bridey Drake, with a video posted four days ago. Over one hundred and forty-eight thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-eight seconds. It also has over three point eight million views.
Next up, number nine, from Australia, Lily Jay, with “Muslims making HISTORY”. Over one hundred and forty-nine thousand likes. It also has over two point six million views.

In position number eight, from Australia, OFF RUNWAY , with a video posted four days ago. Over one hundred and fifty-seven thousand likes. A Short of just sixteen seconds. It also has over three million views.

Coming in at number seven, Dino Says, with “Comment DINO if you want one!”. Over one hundred and ninety-three thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nineteen seconds.
At number six, xxsni, with “The way Manon regretted what she said”. Over one hundred and ninety-six thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-one seconds. It also has over nine point two million views.

At number five, Zack D. Films, with “Why Your Brain Focuses On Negative Things”. Over two hundred and ten thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and sixty thousand views per hour. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

Next up, number four, RpmCentralTV, with “Soaked?”. Over two hundred and forty-three thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nine seconds.

Bronze medal, from Australia, Toni and Ryan, with “Great to see people learning about Australia”. Over two hundred and fifty thousand likes. A Short of just fifty seconds. It also has over four point seven million views.
Silver medal, Bloxy Productions, with “In this world rumors become true.”. Over three hundred and twenty-five thousand likes. It also has over ten million views.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “I think we're seeing a glimpse of future Ben...”. Over three hundred and forty-seven thousand likes. It got there in just two days. It also has over nine point eight million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Asia. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Oceania every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
